statement: Every continuous original placement maps by anchor flooring to the audited inner proxies, each contained in its original. These mapped proxies are disjoint and contained in the outward-relaxed stock. Choose the unique integer anchor cell for each proxy. Its actual occupied band area is at least the exact minimum over that entire cell. The sum of floored demand units cannot exceed the floored stock-band area. Thus all63 freshly computed constraints are necessary; independent cell minima deliberately relax shared anchor choices. No finite-angle coefficients or source guard restrictions transfer.
